findings.passage: “Detroit will not be bullied out of its constitutional authority to run free and fair elections. Calls to federalize local voting systems are not only unconstitutional, they are dangerous,” said state Rep. Stephanie A. Young (D-Detroit), Detroit Caucus chair. “And the so-called SAVE Act is just the latest attempt to erect barriers between eligible voters and the ballot box. Michigan already has secure elections. We reject this power grab, and we will fight any effort to suppress voters or undermine local control.”
findings.note: Her quote in a Detroit Caucus release issued the day the state House adopted House Resolution 244, which urged Congress to enact the SAVE Act. She speaks about the SAVE Act and about federal control of local elections.
